subject: Lumina Health — Case Film: logistics, script, and release
messages:
From: Samira Khan <samira.khan@luminahealth.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-18T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Quick: Lumina case film - interested in working with Redwood

Hi Jordan,

We loved the short case film you did for Helix — would Redwood be interested in producing a 2-3 minute case film for Lumina Health? Our product team wants a short customer-facing piece spotlighting how Redwood helped us reduce inference cost and latency for our patient-facing assistant.

High level: 2 speakers (Chief Product Officer + Head of Ops), on-site, short B-roll (office + session shots), and a simple release to sign. Budget is modest; timeline target is early May if possible.

Can you send a high-level plan for script/talking points, schedule options, and what you need from us (release form, on-site contact, legal)? Happy to set a 30-min planning call.

Thanks,
Samira
Samira Khan
Head of Marketing, Lumina Health
samira.khan@luminahealth.com
Attachment: none

Hi Samira — great to hear from you and glad Helix resonated. Thanks for the clear brief.

We can absolutely do a 2–3 minute case film that hits those points. Proposed next steps:
- 30-min planning call this week to confirm messaging and on-site logistics
- Draft talking points + interview questions from our PMM (cc Marissa)
- Release + usage terms via DocuSign; we use a standard customer-release with a logo and B-roll clause (we can surface any Lumina-specific edits)
- Producer will send a shot list and call sheet; we can bring a backup remote recording kit in case on-site audio is problematic

Do you have a preferred day for a 30-min call? I have availability Friday 4/22 between 10:00–12:00 PT. If that works I’ll send a calendar invite and include Ben (producer) and Marissa (PMM).

On DocuSign: we can send the release (I’ll attach our current v2) and you can route to legal. Our standard asks are typical (consent to recording, internal/external marketing use, logo usage). If you have redlines, send them back and we’ll coordinate.

Best,
Jordan Blake

Subject: Draft talking points + interview guide for Lumina (first pass)

Hi Samira, Jordan —

Thanks for looping me in. Attached below is a short first-pass set of talking points and interview questions. I kept it tight so the final film stays under 3 minutes.

Key narrative arc (3 bullets):
- The challenge: scaling patient experience while keeping inference cost predictable
- The solution: how Redwood routing/quantization/caching cut costs and stabilized latency in production
- The outcome: measurable wins (percent cost reduction, latency p99 improvement, and improved CSAT)

Suggested openers (one-sentence soundbites):
- "We needed predictable latency at scale so our patient experience felt instant — Redwood helped make that reliable without breaking the budget."
- "The drop in inference cost let us prioritize product features that matter most to patients."

Interview questions (short):
1) What was the core problem you wanted to solve?
2) Why did you choose Redwood over building internally/other providers?
3) Can you share specific metrics or outcomes?
4) Any memorable customer-facing wins after the rollout?

Logistics notes: we typically record two takes per question, capture 15–30s B-roll of the product and office, and collect a signed release from each on-camera participant.

If you want to tweak tone (more technical vs more customer-facing), tell me and I’ll adapt the script.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Director, Product Marketing — Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

Attachment: (talking points included inline).

Subject: Production plan + proposed shoot window (Lumina)

Hi all —

Producer note / proposed logistics:
- Proposed shoot dates (on-site): May 10 (primary) and May 11 (contingency), arrival 08:45, wrap by 16:30.
- Crew: 2-person shoot (DP + audio engineer), producer on-site, 30-minute walk-through before recording.
- Equipment: mirrorless camera, shotgun mic + lavs, portable LED kit, backup Zoom H6 recorder. We bring a remote-record backup (USB interface + laptop) in case there are AV issues.
- Shot list highlights: two interview set-ups (CPO + Head of Ops), over-the-shoulder product captures, office B-roll, 10–15s cutaways.

Call sheet + shot list attached (redwood_call_sheet_v1.pdf, lumina_shot_list.xlsx). Please confirm who will be on-camera and the on-site liaison/parking/access instructions.

Releases: we’ll send a DocuSign bundle for each participant and a separate Lumina corporate logo license if you want us to use the Lumina mark in the edit. DocuSign link: https://www.docusign.com/en/link/XYZ-DocuSign-Lumina

Notes on rights: Redwood asks for non-exclusive perpetual license for marketing use (web, socials, conference). If Lumina needs narrower usage, flag now and we’ll add a clause in v2.

Attachment: redwood_call_sheet_v1.pdf (call sheet), lumina_shot_list.xlsx (shot list)

—Ben
